caption: The drawing depicts a single candle holder placed on a flat surface. The holder is circular and shallow with a wide brim and an upturned edge; it contains a short, cylindrical candlestick at its center. The candlestick holds a partially melted candle with visible drips of wax running down its sides. Attached to the rim of the holder on the right side is a large, curved handle that loops upward and away from the dish. The image is rendered in shades of gray, suggesting the use of pencil or graphite, and it employs gradient shading to provide depth and dimension to the metallic surface and the waxy texture of the candle. The background is plain and unembellished, drawing focus to the candle holder and its details.
title: Candlestick
